# Composed patterns

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/samples/patterns and the element API. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Small compositions of elements for a common job (confirming a delete, filtering a table, forms, notifications). They are markup only: the elements bring their behaviour, and the wiring that is specific to your data (what a button does, where a toast comes from) is yours to add.

## filter-table: Filter bar, table and bulk actions

Filter chips and a search over a sortable table with row selection; choosing rows reveals a bulk-action bar.

Built from: Table, Input, Select, Field, Tag, Badge, Button group, Pagination, Cluster.

On a phone: Filters wrap; the table scrolls inside its wrapper; the bulk bar stays under the header.

Elements used: `pk-badge` `pk-button` `pk-button-group` `pk-cluster` `pk-field` `pk-field-row` `pk-input` `pk-pagination` `pk-select` `pk-stack` `pk-table` `pk-tag`.

```html
<pk-table label="Items" caption="Items" striped hover selectable cards filterable sort="name" selected='[1,2]' columns='[{"key":"name","label":"Name","sortable":true},{"key":"status","label":"Status"},{"key":"amount","label":"Amount","type":"number","sortable":true}]' rows='[{"id":1,"name":"Item one","status":"Active","amount":"$12.00"},{"id":2,"name":"Item two","status":"Draft","amount":"$8.50"},{"id":3,"name":"Item three","status":"Review","amount":"$20.00"},{"id":4,"name":"Item four","status":"Active","amount":"$5.25"}]'>
<pk-stack slot="toolbar" gap="sm">
<pk-field-row><pk-field label="Search"><pk-input type="search" placeholder="Name or SKU"></pk-input></pk-field><pk-field label="Status"><pk-select value="Any"><option>Any</option><option>Active</option><option>Draft</option></pk-select></pk-field></pk-field-row>
<pk-cluster><span class="muted">Applied:</span><pk-tag removable>Status: Active</pk-tag><pk-tag removable>Price &gt; $5</pk-tag><pk-button size="mini" variant="ghost">Clear all</pk-button></pk-cluster>
</pk-stack>
<pk-button-group slot="bulk" label="Bulk actions"><pk-button size="mini" variant="ghost">Archive</pk-button><pk-button size="mini" variant="ghost">Export</pk-button><pk-button size="mini" variant="warn">Delete</pk-button></pk-button-group>

<pk-badge slot="cell-3-status" variant="warn">Review</pk-badge>
<pk-badge slot="cell-4-status" variant="ok">Active</pk-badge>
<pk-pagination slot="footer" page="1" pages="2" label="Pages"></pk-pagination>
</pk-table>
```

## master-detail-pattern: Master and detail with tabs

A selectable list beside a record with tabs; the selected row is marked and the detail keeps its own actions.

Built from: Grid, Card, List group, Tabs, Field list, Timeline, Badge, Button.

On a phone: The two columns stack; selecting a row scrolls to the detail.

Elements used: `pk-badge` `pk-button` `pk-card` `pk-field-list` `pk-grid` `pk-list-group` `pk-tab` `pk-tab-panel` `pk-tabs` `pk-timeline` `pk-timeline-item`.

```html
<pk-grid columns="2" min="18rem">
<pk-card heading="Items"><pk-list-group variant="action" label="Items"><a href="#">Item one</a><a href="#" aria-current="true"><strong>Item two</strong></a><a href="#">Item three</a></pk-list-group></pk-card>
<pk-card heading="Item two"><pk-button slot="actions" size="mini" variant="ghost">Edit</pk-button>
<pk-tabs value="overview"><pk-tab value="overview">Overview</pk-tab><pk-tab value="history">History</pk-tab>

</pk-tabs></pk-card>
```

## confirm-delete: Confirm before delete

A destructive action asks first: the modal names what will be lost and offers Cancel; the backdrop never dismisses it.

Built from: Button, Dialog, Alert, Card, Stack.

On a phone: The modal fills the screen; both buttons are full-size targets.

Elements used: `pk-alert` `pk-button` `pk-card` `pk-dialog` `pk-stack`.

```html
<pk-card heading="Item two"><pk-stack gap="sm"><p>Deleting removes the item and its history.</p><div><pk-button variant="warn" data-open="#confirm">Delete item</pk-button></div></pk-stack></pk-card>
<pk-dialog id="confirm" heading="Delete Item two?" size="sm"><pk-stack gap="sm"><pk-alert kind="warning">This cannot be undone.</pk-alert><p>Its 3 history entries are deleted as well.</p></pk-stack><pk-button slot="footer" variant="ghost" data-close>Cancel</pk-button><pk-button slot="footer" variant="warn" data-close>Delete</pk-button></pk-dialog>
```

## notifications: Notifications and toasts

Transient toasts for confirmations, inline notices for what needs attention, and a count badge on the bell.

Built from: Toast, Alert, Button, Badge.

On a phone: Toasts stack full-width at the bottom.

Elements used: `pk-alert` `pk-badge` `pk-button` `pk-cluster` `pk-stack` `pk-toast`.

```html
<pk-stack>
<pk-cluster><pk-button variant="ghost">Notifications <pk-badge count="3" variant="danger"></pk-badge></pk-button></pk-cluster>
<pk-alert kind="success">Item saved.</pk-alert>
<pk-alert kind="warning">Two items need a price.</pk-alert>
<pk-stack gap="sm"><pk-toast>Item archived.<pk-button slot="action" size="mini" variant="ghost">Undo</pk-button></pk-toast><pk-toast>Export ready.<a slot="action" href="#">Download</a></pk-toast></pk-stack>
</pk-stack>
```

## forms: Product settings (forms and inputs)

A settings form built only from form elements: sectioned fields with help, counters and validation, money and stepper inputs, dual range, choice controls, tag and colour inputs, a drop zone and a sticky action bar.

Built from: Form, Form section, Field, Input, Textarea, Select, Range, Checkbox, Radio group, Switch, Tag input, Colour input, Dropzone, Form actions, Button.

On a phone: The form is one column; controls keep a 44px height and 16px text so a phone does not zoom on focus.

Elements used: `pk-button` `pk-checkbox` `pk-colour-input` `pk-combobox` `pk-dropzone` `pk-field` `pk-form` `pk-form-actions` `pk-form-section` `pk-input` `pk-otp-input` `pk-radio-group` `pk-range` `pk-rating` `pk-select` `pk-split-button` `pk-switch` `pk-tag-input` `pk-textarea`.

```html
<pk-form summary>
<form>
<pk-form-section heading="Details" description="Shown on the storefront, invoices and packing slips.">
<pk-field label="Product title" required help="Keep it under 80 characters." max="80"><pk-input name="title" value="Widget 1 Cover A" required data-msg-required="Enter a title."></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="SKU" required><pk-input name="sku" value="AC-1001" required></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Status"><pk-select name="status" value="Active"><option>Active</option><option>Draft</option><option>Archived</option></pk-select></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Release date"><pk-input type="date" name="release" value="2026-09-19"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Description" help="Plain text; the storefront theme adds the formatting."><pk-textarea name="description" autogrow max-height="240" rows="3"></pk-textarea></pk-field>
</pk-form-section>

<pk-form-section heading="Pricing and stock" description="Cost feeds FIFO; price is what customers pay.">
<pk-field label="Price"><pk-input name="price" format="money" min="0" value="19.99"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Unit cost" help="From the purchase order line."><pk-input name="cost" format="money" min="0" value="9.5"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Quantity on hand"><pk-input name="onhand" type="number" stepper min="0" max="999" value="12"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Weight (oz)"><pk-input name="weight" type="number" stepper min="0" step="0.5" value="6.4"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Price range shown in filters"><pk-range name="range" dual output value-low="20" value-high="80"></pk-range></pk-field>
</pk-form-section>

<pk-form-section heading="Channels" description="Where this product is sold.">
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Primary channel"><pk-radio-group variant="segmented" name="channel" value="web"><option value="web">Web</option><option value="market">Market</option><option value="live">Live</option></pk-radio-group></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Vendor"><pk-combobox name="vendor" placeholder="Type to search"><option value="acme">Acme Supply</option><option value="diamond">Diamond</option><option value="local">Local shop</option></pk-combobox></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Shipping profile"><pk-combobox mode="select" name="shipping" value="ground" placeholder="Choose a profile"><option value="ground">Ground (3-5 days)</option><option value="priority">Priority</option><option value="pickup">Local pickup</option></pk-combobox></pk-field>
<div class="form-span"><pk-switch name="storefront" checked label-position="between">Active on the storefront</pk-switch><pk-switch name="preorder" label-position="between">Pre-order until the release date</pk-switch><pk-checkbox name="tax" checked>Charge sales tax</pk-checkbox></div>
</pk-form-section>

<pk-form-section heading="Condition, media and labels" description="Grading, images and search tags.">
<pk-field label="Condition"><pk-radio-group name="condition" value="nm"><option value="nm">Near mint</option><option value="vf">Very fine</option><option value="g">Good</option></pk-radio-group></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Customer rating shown on the page"><pk-rating name="rating" value="4"></pk-rating></pk-field>
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Tags" help="Enter or comma adds a tag."><pk-tag-input name="tags" max="8" value="dc,variant"></pk-tag-input></pk-field>
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Images" help="JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each."><pk-dropzone name="images" accept="image/*" multiple max-size="5MB" max-files="4">Drop images here or click to choose<span slot="hint">JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB each, 4 files at most</span></pk-dropzone></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Label colour"><pk-colour-input name="colour" value="#4a90e2"></pk-colour-input></pk-field>
</pk-form-section>

<pk-form-section heading="Access" description="Sign-in details for the linked supplier portal.">
<pk-field label="Portal password"><pk-input type="password" name="portal" reveal autohide="15" autocomplete="current-password"></pk-input></pk-field>
<pk-field label="Verification code" help="From the authenticator app."><pk-otp-input name="code" length="6" separator-at="3"></pk-otp-input></pk-field>
<pk-field class="form-span" label="Search the catalogue"><pk-input type="search" name="q" clearable debounce="250" placeholder="Search products"></pk-input></pk-field>
</pk-form-section>

<pk-form-actions sticky align="end"><span slot="status">Unsaved changes</span><pk-button variant="ghost" type="reset">Cancel</pk-button><pk-split-button type="submit"><span>Save</span><button slot="menu" type="submit" value="close">Save and close</button><button slot="menu" type="submit" value="new">Save and new</button></pk-split-button></pk-form-actions>
</form>
</pk-form>
```
